review.abstention_reason: The supplied observations explicitly state that this chunk lacks the complete implementation of signal ingestion, processing, and alerting pathways. While metadata and registration changes are present, the end-to-end behavior and connector implementation are missing, preventing a defensible assessment of PostHog relevance or tier. No score assigned.
review.posthog_relevance: None established; implementation and end-to-end behavior are absent.
review.reason: The patch adds metadata and registration for AWS and Microsoft Defender security signals, but the observations note the absence of the actual ingestion, processing, and alerting implementation. Without these, the change cannot be classified as a substantive capability improvement, and no tier can be assigned.
review.uncertainty: The observations themselves admit the chunk is incomplete, making it impossible to distinguish between a narrow metadata-only change and a broader implementation. No tier is assigned.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the signal ingestion, processing, or alerting pathways. It lacks the actual connector implementation, the signal processing and alerting configuration, and the complete frontend integration. While the backend contracts and registration are present, the end-to-end behavior cannot be verified. No score assigned.
